newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa Cargo board duties restructured.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo board duties restructured.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said it has re-structured the responsibilities of its three board members.
Chairman Wilhelm Althen is responsible for network planning, flight operations and Frankfurt operations, a company statement said.
The controlling, corporate strategy and subsidiaries departments and public relations and environmental managers also report directly to him, it added.

A new board member, Stefan Lauer, currently strategic group development manager of parent company Deutsche Lufthansa AG, will be responsible for sales and marketing on joining the company on January 1, 1997.
He will cover global freight sales, business development and global account management, product management and co-ordination of strategic alliances, the statement said.
Previously Althen was responsible for corporate and network planning, marketing and sales.
Rainer Butz, who joins the DHL International board on January 1, has been responsible for logistics and production, including flight operations.
Walter Gehl remains responsible for personnel and commercial affairs, including finance and information systems. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
